Professional Summary

Workforce Data Operations Architect & Business Systems Administrator with 15 years of operational leadership and 5+ years of hands-on experience optimizing enterprise data infrastructure, administering software systems, and executing data governance across healthcare and multi-stakeholder environments. Grounded in public service, equity, and labor governance, specializing in translating frontline operational friction into actionable technical requirements and executive-level insights.

Core Competencies

  • Data Engineering & Analytics: Python & SQL Programming, dbt, BigQuery, REST APIs & Middleware Integration, Advanced Microsoft Excel, Kimball Dimensional Modeling, Cloud Platforms (GCP, AWS).
  • Systems & Software Administration: Enterprise EHR/ERP migration (NextGen to Epic), system configuration, user access provisioning, ITIL framework alignment, and SLA compliance.
  • Operations & Governance: Enterprise asset management, IT helpdesk incident triage, root-cause troubleshooting, technical documentation/runbooks, and data quality control.
  • Stakeholder Leadership: Executive-level briefings, cross-functional group collaboration, business requirements gathering, and labor governance (300+ personnel).
